karate-js: runaway recursion is a RangeError wherever the stack overflow lands. The recursion guard's RangeError was right, but the error path that follows runs on an almost exhausted stack and could fail on first-use work: MemoryResource.getLine compiled its line-break regex lazily (via Interpreter.evalStatement's host message), and Pattern.compile turned the StackOverflowError into a PatternSyntaxException that reached the host as an EngineException with no JS error name (the intermittent CI failure); and an invokedynamic string concat whose first link overflows is broken for the life of the JVM, which in a fresh JVM made every later error fail (JsError.toString, poisoned because JsFunctionNode's warm-up used an empty message; evalStatement's file:// System.err line). The line-break pattern is compiled at class load in MemoryResource, PathResource and UrlResource, the warm-up builds the real "Maximum call stack size exceeded" RangeError, and the file:// line uses a StringBuilder. EngineExceptionTest.testDeepRecursionIsARangeErrorWhereverTheOverflowLands sweeps 200 starting depths, caught and uncaught (failing first: 3/3 runs, at depth 12). Scratch sweeps before/after: warm JVM 73-144/300 wrong -> 0, fresh JVM 300/300 -> 0, file scripts 200/200 -> 0. karate-js 1880/0/0 (2 skipped), karate-core 2958/0/0 (3 skipped).

karate-core: the OAuth2 resource owner password grant. PasswordAuthHandler implements OAuth2AuthHandler: it posts username, password, client_id, client_secret and scope, caches the token until it expires, refreshes it with its refresh token (keeping the old one when the answer has none), and signs in again when there is none or the refresh is refused; a rejected sign-in throws OAuth2Exception with the server's error. configure auth { type: 'oauth2', grantType: 'password', username, password } selects it. The cURL preview places <your-oauth2-access-token> for any OAuth2AuthHandler, not only client credentials, so an authorization-code preview no longer opens the browser. DESIGN's example names accessTokenUrl, the key the code reads. Failing first: PasswordAuthHandlerTest (3), MockE2eTest.testConfigureAuthOAuth2Password, HttpRequestBuilderCurlTest.testPreviewModeWithPasswordGrant. karate-core -Pcicd 3200/0/0 (4 skipped).
